literal_meaning: জিভকে বন্ধ রাখা (keeping the tongue closed)
figurative_meaning_en: To remain silent after observing everything
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সব দেখেশুনে জিভ বন্ধ রেখেছে।
এই পরিস্থিতিতে জিভ বন্ধ রাখাই উচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: He kept his tongue in check after seeing everything.
It's wise to hold your tongue in this situation.
note: This idiom emphasizes the cultural value of discretion in Bengali speech patterns.
